title: Queen Palm
body:
Description

Queen Palm is a type of tree that spawns exclusively on an island that can be accessed through the Oak Desert on Ferwater Island, along with the two smaller palms, King Palm and Palm. It is the largest of the palm tree-o and produces a vibrant yellow color in its wood and planks.

Its large logs make it difficult to bring back to your base to saw and plank with the Industrial Sander & Steel Planker, as the logs take up a lot of space, requiring you need to cut the logs to very small pieces, making the entire process a challenge.
